items.text: Verified current codebase state: FAB is z-30 with bottom calc(5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) in floating-action-button.tsx. Sidebar <aside> is z-30 in Sidebar.tsx. Other z-40 consumers (FloatingPanel, detail overlay, GraphHelpPanel) are spatially separated from the sidebar on desktop, and on mobile the sidebar goes full-screen so overlap is irrelevant.

The sidebar already has a responsive right-offset on the FAB (md:right-[21.5rem]) when open on desktop. After raising sidebar to z-40, this offset becomes cosmetic rather than essential — the sidebar will cover the FAB regardless. The offset can be kept for visual polish or removed in a future cleanup.

items.context: This is a pure CSS fix (2 lines across 2 files). The changes are visual and don't affect component logic. We need to decide how to verify correctness.

options.label: Manual visual verification only
options.rationale: Since these are purely visual CSS changes (z-index and position), automated tests would just assert class names which is brittle and low-value. Manual check across desktop/mobile viewports is sufficient.

options.label: Add snapshot/unit tests for z-index classes
options.rationale: Would catch accidental regressions to z-index values, but is fragile — any Tailwind class reordering breaks the test. Maintenance cost likely exceeds value for a 2-line change.

items.topic: Keep or remove FAB right-offset when sidebar is open
items.context: The FAB currently shifts right via md:right-[21.5rem] when sidebar is open (passed as className prop by the parent). After raising sidebar to z-40, the sidebar will cover the FAB anyway, making this offset unnecessary. However, if the sidebar is ever made semi-transparent or the z-index changes again, the offset provides a safety net.

options.label: Keep the right-offset as-is (no change)
options.rationale: Don't touch what we don't need to. The offset is harmless and provides defense-in-depth. Keeps this fix minimal.

options.label: Remove the right-offset since sidebar now covers FAB
options.rationale: Cleaner code — removes a now-unnecessary responsive class. But increases scope and removes a useful fallback.

items.text: This plan appears ready for execution. All dimensions are at 2+ and the implementation is a straightforward 2-line CSS change with clear before/after states. Consider reviewing and queuing after resolving the two remaining decisions.

plan_updates: Incorporated round 1 decisions into plan: sidebar raised to z-40, FAB bottom reduced from 5rem to 3rem. Added 'Accepted Decisions' section, detailed implementation steps, updated z-index hierarchy table to show target state, and expanded risk table with severity/mitigation columns.
